newsitem.title: MAURITIUS: Cyclone Gretelle moves away from Mauritius.
newsitem.headline: Cyclone Gretelle moves away from Mauritius.

text.p: Severe tropical depression Gretelle was moving away from Mauritius on Wednesday but the Indian Ocean island's population was still urged to remain on alert for cyclones, the local weather services office said.
At 4 a.m. (0000 GMT), Gretelle was centred at 360 km (220 miles) northwest of Mauritius and was slowly moving away in a west southwest direction at five km per hour, the services said.
Owing to Gretelle's proximity, overnight strengthening and the risk that it could still change direction towards Mauritius, the weather office urged the islanders to remain vigilant.

In the last two days Gretelle brought abundant rain without inflicting strong and damaging winds to this sugar-cane growing island. Officials in the sugar industry said such conditions were beneficial to the sugar-cane in its growing stage.
